title: Committee of Supply – Head J (Ministry of Defence)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head J (Ministry of Defence)

sections.label: Head J budget reduction motion
sections.summary: The Chairman moves that the total sum allocated for Head J of the Estimates be reduced by $100.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head J of the Estimates be reduced by $100".

sections.label: SAF threats and constraints
sections.summary: Singapore does not look for trouble but trouble may come, and SAF faces falling manpower and less training space.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: While Singapore does not look for trouble, trouble may well come to us and we have to be ready.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: However, while our threats are growing and evolving, SAF faces two key constraints – falling manpower arising from a fall in our birth rates and less available spaces for training as land gets put to other uses.

sections.label: Air Force and Navy replacements
sections.summary: The Minister announced F-35 fighter jets to replace F-16s and four Invincible-class submarines to replace current submarines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The Minister has announced the Air Force is going to acquire F-35 fighter jets to eventually replace its F-16s.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In relation to the Navy, plans were announced to replace the Republic of Singapore Navy's current submarines with four Invincible-class submarines.

sections.label: RSAF Fighter Training Detachment Guam
sections.summary: MINDEF announced an MOU between the US and Singapore to establish an RSAF Fighter Training Detachment in Guam.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: MINDEF recently announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the US and Singapore to establish a Republic of Singapore Air Force (RSAF) Fighter Training Detachment in Guam (FTD-Guam).

sections.label: Malaysian vessels in Singapore waters
sections.summary: Last year, two Malaysian vessels were in Singapore waters, which appeared to be a provocative act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: Last year, we had two Malaysian vessels in Singapore waters, which appeared to be a provocative act.

sections.label: Sea robbery in Malacca Straits
sections.summary: In December 2019, a report noted increasing sea robbery incidents in the Malacca Straits, higher since 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: More recently, in December 2019, there was a report of increasing incidents of sea robbery taking place in the Malacca Straits and the number of such incidents has been higher since 2018.

sections.label: ASEAN defence ministers air guidelines
sections.summary: MINDEF chaired the 12th ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting in October 2019, which adopted the ASEAN Guidelines for Air Military Encounters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: In October 2019, MINDEF chaired the 12th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Defence Ministers' Meeting (ADMM).

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: The ADMM adopted the ASEAN Guidelines for Air Military Encounters (GAME).

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: It is perhaps the first such set of multilateral guidelines in the world.

sections.label: Singapore Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
sections.summary: Singapore signed the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with Australia in June 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong (Punggol East)
sentences.text: Singapore signed the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) with Australia in June 2015.

sections.label: Exercise Wallaby Shoalwater Bay training
sections.summary: Last year's Exercise Wallaby involved some 3,000 SAF personnel, and this year marks 30 years of using Shoalwater Bay.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong (Punggol East)
sentences.text: Last year's Exercise Wallaby, held from September to November, involved some 3,000 SAF personnel in an area almost four times the size of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong (Punggol East)
sentences.text: This year, I believe, will mark the 30th year that we have been able to use the Shoalwater Bay training area.

sections.label: Fighters returning to Southeast Asia
sections.summary: Former fighters who acquired skills in Iraq and Syria are returning to Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Former fighters, who have acquired skills from their experiences in Iraq and Syria, are returning to Southeast Asia.

sections.label: CBRNE materials used by terrorists
sections.summary: CBRNE materials are utilised by terrorists to attack people and infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: CBRNE materials − chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear and explosives – are utilised by terrorists to attack people and infrastructure.

sections.label: Coastal and Flood Protection Fund
sections.summary: The Government committed $5 billion to the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund and pledged to top it up when the Budget permits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The Government has committed $5 billion to the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund to fend off the encroaching sea and pledged to top up this fund whenever our Budget permits in the future.

sections.label: Empoldering Pulau Tekong training space
sections.summary: Empoldering is adding 810 hectares of military training space to Pulau Tekong's north-western tip, slated for completion in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Empoldering is being used to add 810 hectares of military training space to the north-western tip of Pulau Tekong.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: This project was slated to be completed in 2022.

sections.label: Defence budget spending rise
sections.summary: Defence spending rose from S$14.8 billion in 2018 to S$15.47 billion in 2019, and this year's S$15.1 billion is the highest among all Ministries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Douglas Foo (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: While such expenditure is necessary for modernisation, we have seen budget spending on defence rise steadily from S$14.8 billion in 2018 to S$15.47 billion in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Douglas Foo (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: While there is a slight drop in this year's Budget to S$15.1 billion, it is still the highest expenditure among all the Ministries.

sections.label: Singapore aircraft purchase US approval
sections.summary: Singapore's purchase of up to 12 aircraft for an estimated US$2.75 billion is undergoing US Congressional approval, dogged by cost overruns and reliability questions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: As of January, Singapore's purchase of up to 12 aircraft for an estimated US$2.75 billion is undergoing the US Congressional approval process.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: However, the programme has been dogged by cost overruns and questions about reliability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: There were also issues regarding the leak of confidential data that required costly redesigns and retrofits from various vendors and subcontractors.

sections.label: SAF Inspector-General's Office setup
sections.summary: Before last year's COS debate, SAF announced an Inspector-General's Office to scrutinise safety practices across all services and units.

sentences.speaker: Mr Charles Chong
sentences.text: Just before last year's COS debate, SAF announced the setting up of an Inspector-General's Office (IGO) to scrutinise safety practices at all levels across all services in the units of SAF.

sections.label: Training accident inquiry findings
sections.summary: The Committee of Inquiry into the training accidents found they happened due to lapses by the servicemen involved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Chairman, the Committee of Inquiry into the training accidents had found that training-related accidents happened due to lapses by the servicemen involved.

sections.label: SkillsFuture@NS support for NSFs
sections.summary: MINDEF introduced SkillsFuture@NS initiatives at last year's COS to support NSFs' lifelong learning, with questions on updates and time and financial support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: MINDEF took some steps in this direction at last year's COS with the introduction of a suite of SkillsFuture@NS initiatives to support our NSF's lifelong learning journey.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Would the Ministry provide an update of what MINDEF is doing to help our NSFs refresh or acquire new skills as part of their post-ORD transition?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: I am curious about what support measures MINDEF offers in terms of time allocation and financial support for these NSFs to commit to these courses.

sections.label: NS Hub status update
sections.summary: MINDEF announced the NS Hub in 2023 to centralise pre-enlistment processes, and a Minister is asked for a status update.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy
sentences.text: At the COS debate last year, MINDEF announced that it would be unveiling the NS Hub in 2023, a single facility that centralises pre-enlistment processes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy
sentences.text: Could the Minister please provide an update on the status of the NS Hub?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Chairman, in 2017, we celebrated 50 years of NS in Singapore.

sections.label: Operationally Ready NSman training cycle
sections.summary: He becomes an Operationally Ready NSman and begins a 10-year ORNS training cycle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Douglas Foo
sentences.text: Instead, he becomes an Operationally Ready NSman (ORNS), to begin his 10-year ORNS training cycle.

sections.label: SMF supports SAF ceremony
sections.summary: SMF has supported the SAF Re-dedication Ceremony each year since its involvement in 2013.

sentences.speaker: Mr Douglas Foo
sentences.text: SMF has been supporting the SAF Re-dedication Ceremony each year since its involvement in 2013.

sections.label: NSmen annual In-Camp Training
sections.summary: NSmen spend two to three weeks away from their families for annual In-Camp Training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Douglas Foo
sentences.text: Besides our young men who set aside two years to serve full-time, our NSmen have to spend two to three weeks away from their families when they return to do their annual In-Camp Training.

sections.label: Defence Cybersecurity Centre announced
sections.summary: At the COS debate last year, the Minister for Defence announced a Defence Cybersecurity Centre would be set up.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: At the COS debate last year, the Minister for Defence announced that a Defence Cybersecurity Centre would be set up.

sections.label: SAF vendor data leaks
sections.summary: Two instances last year involved data leaks of SAF personnel from contracted vendors through malware and ransomware.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: Two instances last year have been instructive and both involved data leak of SAF personnel from vendors contracted to SAF, through malicious malware and ransomware.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: Clearly, we see that there are unfriendly elements watching to see what weaknesses our systems may contain so that they can exploit them.

sections.label: Digital Defence pillar introduced
sections.summary: MINDEF and the Ministry of Communications and Information introduced Digital Defence as a Total Defence pillar in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: Given the pervasiveness of digital threats, MINDEF and the Ministry of Communications and Information introduced Digital Defence as a pillar of Total Defence in 2019.

sections.label: North West 911 app
sections.summary: Volunteers from the North West CDC developed an app to help Singaporeans respond to 14 crisis scenarios and administer basic first aid.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin
sentences.text: Civic participation manifested in the form of an app called North West 911, developed by volunteers from the North West Community Development Council (CDC).

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin
sentences.text: This app can help Singaporeans to better cope and respond to 14 crisis scenarios and administer basic first aid, among other functions.

sections.label: Total Defence and Climate Defence
sections.summary: Singapore adopts a whole-of-society approach; Total Defence began in 1984, Digital Defence was added in 2019, and Climate Defence is now proposed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: Singapore adopts a whole-of-society approach to national security.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: Total Defence was conceptualised in 1984 as a comprehensive model for the defence of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: In 2019, we added Digital Defence as cyber threats were as grave as physical ones.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: Today, in 2020, I am asking this House to consider one more – Climate Defence.

sections.label: Climate Defence pillar question
sections.summary: The passage asks whether MINDEF would consider adopting Climate Defence as a pillar of Total Defence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: In line with this approach, would MINDEF consider adopting Climate Defence as a pillar of Total Defence?

sections.label: SAF restructuring for challenges
sections.summary: The SAF must restructure decisively to meet new security challenges and remain relevant, responsive and effective for national defence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Even so, to respond to a new environment of security challenges, the SAF must again restructure decisively to meet new challenges, to remain relevant, responsive and effective for our national defence.

sections.label: Geopolitics and rising powers
sections.summary: Members agreed Singapore has entered a messier, less predictable geopolitical phase, with China, Japan, India and Australia gaining strength.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Members have talked about it – Mr Charles Chong, Mr Desmond Choo, Ms Sylvia Lim, Mr Vikram Nair.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: I agree completely with Members that, along with the rest of the world, Singapore has entered a different phase in geopolitics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: It is messier, less predictable and, therefore, with more unseen events.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: The post-World War II era of 70 years, championed and spearheaded by a hyper-dominant US together with its Western liberal allies, is no longer the only and main narrative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: China is a rising global power but regional powers, too, are gaining strength, including Japan, India and Australia.

sections.label: US and China defence agreements
sections.summary: Singapore renewed the 1990 US facilities Memorandum of Understanding for 15 years and enhanced the 2008 China defence exchanges agreement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: With the US, as Members observed, we renewed a key document – the 1990 Memorandum of Understanding for the US’ use of facilities in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: The renewal, signed between Prime Minister Lee and President Trump, allows the US forces’ continued access to our air and naval bases for another 15 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: With China, we enhanced the 2008 Agreement on Defence Exchanges and Security Cooperation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: This year will be the first time the SAF is planning to conduct two bilateral exercises with the PLA in the same year.

sections.label: Australia Shoalwater Bay training
sections.summary: The 30th year of Singapore's training in Shoalwater Bay with Australia, a strategic partner, is being marked with joint training facilities on schedule.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: With Australia, as Mr Charles Chong said, the 30th year of our training in Shoalwater Bay this year, our strategic partner, we are building our joint training facilities and it is on schedule.

sections.label: ASEAN Our Eyes intelligence sharing
sections.summary: Efforts were stepped up and intelligence sharing formalised through the ASEAN "Our Eyes" initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Against them, we have stepped up efforts and formalised intelligence sharing through the ASEAN "Our Eyes" initiative.

sections.label: Integrated cyber command and force
sections.summary: An integrated cyber command and force is to be built to defend Singapore's digital borders against foreign cyber actors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: In the SAF’s history, this is as important as raising another service, just like Army, Navy and Air Force, namely, to build an integrated cyber command and force to defend our digital borders, especially against foreign cyber actors, both state and non-state, who seek to undermine our stability and/or pose a threat to national security.

sections.label: Maritime security and Malacca Straits Patrol
sections.summary: The RSN's Maritime Security Task Force will acquire new platforms and four refurbished patrol vessels, and Singapore proposed extending the Malacca Straits Patrol.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: The Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN’s) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) will be acquiring new purpose built platforms that can enhance our capabilities to deal with such threats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: For a start, four refurbished patrol vessels will be dedicated and deployed for greater assistance to protect our territorial waters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: But all of us know that maritime threats are transnational in nature and cannot be solved without cooperation and collaboration of our neighbours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: We have reached out to our counterparts in Malaysia and Indonesia to propose that the Malacca Straits Patrol initiative, which has worked so well through coordinated patrols to reduce piracy in the Malacca Strait, be extended to other areas in our surrounding waters.

sections.label: Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership training facilities
sections.summary: Under the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with Australia, the SAF will get modern instrumented training ranges in an area about 10 times Singapore's size.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: And let me give some updates under our Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with Australia, which will be a key node for best of class training facilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It will provide the SAF with modern instrumented training ranges, such as the Combined Arms Air-Land Ranges and the Urban Operations Live Firing facilities, in an area approximately 10 times the size of Singapore.

sections.label: Shoalwater Bay Greenvale training facilities
sections.summary: When Shoalwater Bay and Greenvale are completed, SAF can train up to 14,000 personnel annually across all three Services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: In essence, when completed, we can conduct complex training on a much larger scale, that only few militaries are able to, elsewhere.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We expect construction at Shoalwater Bay to be completed by 2024 and Greenvale – that is another site – to be completed by 2028.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: When these facilities are completed, SAF will be able to conduct integrated training across all three Services, involving up to 14,000 personnel annually and over a span of up to 18 weeks.

sections.label: F-35 acquisition and deployment
sections.summary: MINDEF is finalising acquisition of four F-35s with an option for eight more, to be deployed in the US around 2026.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: MINDEF is in the final stages of acquiring our four F-35s, with an option to purchase eight more.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: And when delivered, which we hope will be around 2026, the F-35Bs will be deployed in the US for training and in-depth evaluation.

sections.label: F-35 fleet evaluation
sections.summary: The F-15s and F-16s are adequate, and the F-35s will be fully evaluated, including cost and maintenance, before deciding on a full fleet.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We are in no hurry – the F-15s and F-16s are adequate for our air defence and air capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: And we will evaluate them fully, including all the questions that were attributed to the F-35s, including cost and maintenance, before we decide fully on a full fleet of the F-35s.

sections.label: Army mask distribution
sections.summary: The Army packed 5.2 million masks and delivered them to 89 Community Centres and Clubs for 1.37 million households within two days.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: At very short notice, the Army packed 5.2 million masks, delivered them to 89 Community Centres and Clubs to distribute to 1.37 million households within two days.

sections.label: Replacing administrative vehicles
sections.summary: MINDEF intends to replace 400 administrative vehicles to reduce CO2 emissions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: First, we intend to replace our 400 administrative vehicles to reduce CO2 emissions.

sections.label: Net positive energy hangar and sustainability
sections.summary: A net positive energy hangar at Changi Air Base will be delivered, with efforts to reduce 11,400 tonnes of CO2 emissions and mitigate flood and fire risks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: In March, which we already are, we will deliver the first net positive energy aircraft hangar at Changi Air Base which can generate more electricity than that consumed due to certain features that were incorporated into the design of the hangar.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: When fully realised, these efforts combined will reduce 11,400 tonnes of CO2 emissions by the end of this financial year and support our national efforts to combat climate change.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We are working with the Australian Department of Defence to incorporate environmentally sustainable design measures, such as solar-powered lighting and using building materials that have a higher proportion of recycled content.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We are taking proactive efforts to mitigate flood and fire risks, through the use of flood modelling, and the construction of fire breaks and the use of non-combustible fire-rated materials.

sections.label: Number of ICTs unchanged
sections.summary: The number of ICTs for each NSman will remain the same.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The number of ICTs for each NSman will remain the same.

sections.label: Defence spending growth commitment
sections.summary: Defence spending will avoid sharp ups and downs, keep pace with inflation at about 3% to 4% nominal increase yearly, with a 3.2% projected increase this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, as I have indicated previously, we can continue to maintain and grow the SAF with a defence spending that avoids sharp ups and downs but which at least keeps pace with inflation, about 3% to 4% nominal increase each year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The commitment holds, with a projected increase for this year's Budget over last year's of 3.2%.

sections.label: Hunter AFVs maintenance savings
sections.summary: The Army's Hunter Armoured Fighting Vehicles commissioned last year were chosen for new capabilities and maintenance-friendly design, saving up to 40% in maintenance costs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, for example, the Army's Hunter Armoured Fighting Vehicles (AFVs) that were commissioned last year were chosen not only for their new capabilities but because they were maintenance-friendly by design.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We saved up to 40% in maintenance costs as compared to other armoured vehicles.

sections.label: SAF IGO formed
sections.summary: Last February, the SAF IGO was formed to scrutinise and enforce safety measures in SAF units.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Last February, the SAF IGO was formed to scrutinise and enforce the safety measures in SAF units.

sections.label: IGO audit progress
sections.summary: The IGO has audited 70% of all formations and their sub-units across the SAF and will complete this first round by September this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: The IGO has already audited 70% of all formations and their sub-units across the SAF and they will complete this first round of audits by September this year.

sections.label: Project Serve SCDF attachment
sections.summary: The SAF has partnered SCDF under Project Serve to create a six-month attachment within the SCDF's national emergency ambulances to enhance competencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: To enhance their competencies, the SAF has partnered SCDF, under an initiative known as Project Serve, to create a six-month attachment within the SCDF's national emergency ambulances.

sections.label: COVID-19 measures for NS pre-enlistees
sections.summary: MINDEF and SAF follow Government advisories, giving pre-enlistees who travelled to China mandatory Leave of Absence and deferring In-Camp Training for NSmen who travelled to China.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: MINDEF and SAF take reference from the Government's advisories, guidelines and requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: We gave pre-enlistees who have travelled to China and are due for enlistment a mandatory Leave of Absence (LOA) and deferred In-Camp Training for NSmen who have travelled to China.

sections.label: SAF camp preventive measures at DORSCON Orange
sections.summary: With DORSCON Orange, SAF stepped up camp measures: personnel take temperature twice daily, workplaces are disinfected more often, and meal times are staggered.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: With the change to DORSCON Orange, the SAF has also stepped up preventive measures within camps, requiring our personnel to take their temperature twice daily, conducting more frequent disinfection of workplaces as well as staggering meal times.

sections.label: NS Coordinators in foreign schools
sections.summary: MINDEF partnered ACCORD to appoint dedicated NS Coordinators in Foreign System Schools and Privately Funded Institutions to assist with NS questions and clarifications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: To better equip this group, we partnered the Advisory Council on Community Relations in Defence (ACCORD) to appoint dedicated NS Coordinators in Foreign System Schools and Privately Funded Institutions in order to assist with their questions and clarifications about NS.

sections.label: PREP4NS SAFRA gym membership sign-ups
sections.summary: Under PREP4NS, pre-enlistees can sign up for a one-year complimentary membership to six SAFRA gyms, with about 6,000 signed up since last November's launch.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Under PREP4NS, pre-enlistees can sign up for a one-year complimentary membership to six SAFRA gyms conveniently located in different parts of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: We have so far about 6,000 pre-enlistees signed up for the membership since its launch last November.

sections.label: SkillsFuture@NS for NSFs after ORD
sections.summary: MINDEF introduced SkillsFuture@NS last year, letting NSFs use $350 in E-PREP credits to access training and choose from about 3,000 courses after ORD.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: To help our NSFs acquire new skills as they transit to studies or work after their ORD, MINDEF introduced the "SkillsFuture@NS" initiative last year where NSFs can use their E-PREP credits, which is $350 worth of E-PREP credits, and they may access training and choose from a pool of about 3,000 courses.

sections.label: Increase in monthly NS allowance
sections.summary: To recognise NS personnel contributions, monthly NS allowance quantums, which vary by rank, vocation and deployment, will rise by an additional $70 to $120.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: In order to recognise the contributions of our NS personnel, we have also increased the monthly NS allowance quantums from their current levels, which varies according to their rank, vocation, deployment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: They will go up by between an additional $70 and an additional $120.

sections.label: Infrared scanners and e-services
sections.summary: Infrared scanners introduced in 2015 measure body dimensions, and improved e-services from June will let pre-enlistees complete most transactions online.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Infrared scanners were introduced in 2015 to measure body dimensions quickly and accurately.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Come June this year, we will complement these onsite enhancements with improved e-services to provide our pre-enlistees an even more hassle-free experience of completing most transactions online.

sections.label: New NS Hub smart technologies
sections.summary: The NS Hub, to be completed in 2023, will integrate smart technologies like biometric identification, expected to cut waiting time by about a third.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: As for the new NS Hub to be completed in 2023 which Mr Arasu Duraisamy asked about, that will integrate smart technologies, such as biometric identification and other initiatives on trial at CMPB today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: These, we expect, will cut waiting time by about a third.

sections.label: We Support NS merchant discounts
sections.summary: Under the We Support NS campaign, over 540 merchants, businesses and hawkers offered discounts to past and present NSmen last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How)
sentences.text: Under the "We Support NS" campaign, over 540 merchants, businesses and hawkers last year offered a wide selection of discounts to past and present NSmen.

sections.label: Budget 2020 COVID-19 business measures
sections.summary: Budget 2020 announced measures for businesses affected by the outbreak, with companies cutting costs and wages and offering rental relief.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: In Budget 2020, the Government has announced measures to help businesses directly affected by the outbreak.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Companies like Singapore Airlines, Singtel and Singapore Mass Rapid Transit (SMRT) are finding ways to avoid retrenching their workers by cutting capital spending, operating costs and wages for managerial staff.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Some, like CapitaLand and Changi Airport, have also offered rental relief to help retailers cope with the COVID-19 crisis.

sections.label: Fake news speed and COVID-19
sections.summary: An MIT study found fake news travels six times faster than true stories, and false COVID-19 information on school and MRT closures spread last month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: According to a Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Study, fake news can travel six times faster than true stories.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: In the past month, false information on the closure of schools and the closure of an MRT station due to the spread of COVID-19 was propagated.

sections.label: Digital Defence in BMT
sections.summary: MINDEF, SSG, NLB and CSA added a Digital Defence component, and BMT recruits must complete a digital security e-module and visit an exhibition.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: As part of a broader effort to raise information literacy and increase Singaporeans’ understanding of digital threats, MINDEF, SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG), the National Library Board (NLB) and the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore had worked together to add a Digital Defence component to the SkillsFuture for Digital Workplace programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: At the same time, MINDEF/SAF has partnered NLB to enrich our existing Basic Military Training (BMT) curriculum with content on cyberattacks and information threats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Now, BMT recruits will have to complete an e-module on Digital Security in the SAF and visit the Digital Defence exhibition at the Singapore Discovery Centre.

sections.label: Digital Defence for SME owners
sections.summary: MINDEF, SSG, SUSS and NLB collaborate to add a Digital Defence component teaching SME owners the SURE framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: One of the many efforts to achieve this is a collaboration between MINDEF, SSG, the Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS) and NLB to introduce a Digital Defence component into the SUSS SME Resilience, Entrepreneurship and Nurturing programme to teach SME business owners how to use the Source, Understand, Research and Evaluate (SURE) framework to better assess the reliability of information.

sections.label: Cyber NSF specialists and DCSC
sections.summary: The first batch of Cyber NSF Specialists has been deployed, and the DCSC reached 24/7 operating capability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: In addition, I am happy to announce that the first batch of Specialists from the Cyber NSF scheme has been deployed into our cyber defence operations across MINDEF/SAF.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: The Defence Cyber Security Centre (DCSC) which was announced in 2019, has also reached 24/7 operating capability to monitor, detect and respond to threats.

sections.label: Total Defence board game kit
sections.summary: NTU students, Coding Lab and IMDA developed a Total Defence board game in a kit for preschoolers and low-income families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: One example is the collaboration among four Nanyang Technological University students, the Coding Lab and the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) to develop a Total Defence board game within the Tiny Thinkers Starter Kit, which was given to preschoolers and parents of low-income families, with the aim of exposing young children to Total Defence.

sections.label: SAFRA and HomeTeamNS Family Schemes
sections.summary: MINDEF and MHA will launch the SAFRA and HomeTeamNS Family Schemes, letting all ORNS sign up for a family package.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: To recognise and strengthen family support for all our servicemen, I am happy to announce that MINDEF and the Ministry of Home Affairs will launch the SAFRA Family Scheme and HomeTeamNS Family Scheme this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Under these schemes, all ORNS can sign up for a family package for himself and his dependants, regardless of the size of his family.

sections.label: Total Defence logo competition
sections.summary: The logo competition sought a logo representing all six pillars and received more than 600 designs from participants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: When we launched the logo competition, we wanted to create a new logo that represents all six pillars and, more importantly, to hear from Singaporeans what Total Defence meant to them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: We were heartened to receive more than 600 designs by participants from all walks of life – from students, teachers, professional designers and retirees.

sections.label: SG Together engagement sessions
sections.summary: MINDEF will hold engagement sessions in the second half of 2020 to hear Singaporeans on putting Total Defence into action.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: As part of the SG Together movement, MINDEF will conduct a series of engagement sessions in the second half of 2020, to hear from Singaporeans on how all of us can do better to put Total Defence into action and how Total Defence can be strengthened for our future.

sections.label: F-35 acquisition timeline and agreement
sections.summary: Congressional objections have not been raised, and terms of the sale and purchase agreement are being worked out, with acquisition planned for 2026.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: On the Congressional side, it is not so much approval, but they can raise objections, which they have not.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, basically, those processes have been done and the Member is quite right, we are at a stage where we are doing the terms of the sale and purchase agreement which will include aspects beyond the purchase of the F-35s for us – where we would like to base them when we are training together with the DoD and so on and so forth.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: If all things proceed as we planned, then we will acquire it in 2026, we think.

sections.label: Technical assessment and platform maturity
sections.summary: The Ministry must satisfy itself of a rigorous technical assessment, and pilots and technical staff are confident main problems are ironed out.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Basically, for us in the Ministry, we have to ask questions and satisfy ourselves that there is a rigorous technical assessment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: But if you speak to the pilots and the technical side of the house, they are quite confident that the main problems have been ironed out and that the platform will reach a steady state in which it is operational.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: What I meant was that it is good that we are in no hurry and we have to allow the systems to mature.

sections.label: Whole-of-Government cyber approach
sections.summary: A committee chaired by Senior Minister Teo Chee Hean takes a whole-of-Government approach to cyber, and the Cyber Security Agency protects networks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The cyber arena is enormous and there is a whole-of-Government approach where there is a committee which Senior Minister Teo Chee Hean chairs, looking at the overall picture, not only for cyber but business continuity under various aspects, logistics, so on and so forth.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, let us situate what the SAF does.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: And, of course, we have the Cyber Security Agency, which is primarily responsible for protecting our networks and they were very involved when there was a cyber attack – some Members here talked about data ex-filtration, rightly so – they were the ones.

sections.label: CDF to oversee C4I
sections.summary: It is settled that the CDF should see C4I, and a committee will look at recruitment processes for the needed people.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: But we also want it to be effective and efficacious, as well as efficient.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: So, I think that we have settled that it should be the CDF to see C4I.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: As to how you raise them and what type of people you need, the Member is quite right, and that is why this committee will look at the recruitment processes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We take that, for some, it would be similar to what we raised, for example, technicians in the technical force, but not quite similar; and there will also be certain, I suppose, they sit on the right side of the curve, they are very brilliant, but you do not know whether they can sit nicely in uniform and whether they can adapt to it.
